lastCompletedStory.title: nextActions ephemeral-only: schema + persona hard rule + doc-gate

nextStoryContext: US-005 shipped: this was the LAST story in this PRD (all 5 of CAM-190 now pass:true). scripts/cam/orch-handoff.schema.json gained: (a) a hard-rule sentence appended to the top-level schema description ('no handoff field enumerates the backlog; the backlog is always derived live via `cam issue list` ... never carried forward as a snapshot in this file'); (b) a rewritten `nextActions.description` that frames it as ephemeral, cycle-specific continuation steps only, explicitly stating 'Never a backlog snapshot' and repeating the no-handoff-field-enumerates-backlog hard rule. Both persona copies (.claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md AND templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md, edited identically per CAM-123 self-hosting, re-verified byte-identical before and after) gained one added sentence at the end of the existing 'Write the handoff first' bullet (self-handoff lifecycle section, 'Recycle flow (cycle-close)', step 1 -- grep 'Write the handoff first' to relocate, do not trust line numbers) stating the same two rules using the literal phrases 'never a backlog snapshot' and 'no handoff field enumerates the backlog' (both lowercase-matched by the doc-gate test). test/vendor/orchestrator-backlog-derivation.test.ts (US-004's file) was EXTENDED per its own notes (not a new file): added a new describe block 'embedded orchestrator persona: nextActions ephemeral-only + no-backlog-in-handoff hard rule (US-005)' with two tests asserting those two literal phrases (lowercased) are present in templatesContents['agents/subagent-orchestrator.md']. Ran embed-vendor (regenerated src/vendor/_generated.ts) + embed-vendor:check clean. Full bun run check:all green (3353 tests, typecheck, lint, file-size, debt-markers, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity all ok). No production code (src/commands, src/supervisor, etc.) was touched by this story -- it was schema-description + persona-prose + doc-gate only. Since all non-operator (and there are no operator-tagged) stories in prd.json now pass:true, the next agent invocation should see PRD_COMPLETE and the orchestrator should move to /cam-review for this PRD (CAM-190, issue-list-derived-backlog).
